scope: DASH single-resource track and conditional byte-range parallel downloading

environment.platform: isolated Linux/WSL2 Chrome profile; not the user's Windows profile

unit.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/fragment-parts.test.ts tests/unit/fragment.test.ts tests/unit/multipart.test.ts
coverage: Exact complete resource reconstruction and global 2/4/8 connection budgets
Original URL retained and exact strong ETag/If-Range validation
Missing or weak ETag, ignored Range, small resource, encoding and malformed probe fall back before writes
Version changes, wrong boundaries/total/length, truncated and excessive bodies stop without checkpoint
HTML MIME and HTML/JSON prefix under binary MIME rejected
Cancellation, 120-second inactivity, active transfer beyond two minutes, quota and handle cleanup

initialRun.reason: Pause fixture completed before the manager's one-second refresh exposed the Pause button. Product transfer had completed normally.

browserFixtures.testOnlyCorrection: Increase that fixture response delay from 800 to 3000 milliseconds; no product change after the build.

focusedRerun.command: pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/dash-parallel.spec.ts --grep 'pause aborts'

coverage: Budgets 2/4/8 observed as maximum 2/4/8 active requests across two resource URLs; final AVC/AAC MP4 saved
Disabled preference keeps sequential whole-resource downloading
Absent ETag permits only two distinct complete resources concurrently
Changed ETag stops without a saved result
Pause aborts active requests and releases the owner; resume saves one result

lint.command: pnpm exec eslint tests/e2e/dash-parallel.spec.ts packages/media-core/fragment-parts.ts apps/extension/src/media.worker.ts tests/unit/fragment-parts.test.ts

publicEvidence.result: One native public 144p source: sequential 27814 ms versus parallel 20782 ms, max one versus two complete resource requests, both results saved and fully decoded.
publicEvidence.rangeLimitation: The native CDN supplies no ETag. No acceleration by recombined byte ranges is claimed for real VK.

review.optionalCoverageGap: Two tracks sharing exactly the same resource URL are explicitly kept sequential in code; no dedicated browser fixture covers that guard.

limitations: One public 144p measurement, not a statistical speed benchmark
720p complete download after this change remains unverified
No new test of the user's Windows browser profile or a physical TV receiver
Global build, Store packaging and complete repository checks are reported by the coordinating task
